publicationId.description: The prefixed ID of the publication object

automationId.description: The prefixed ID of the automation object

status.description: Optionally filter the results by the automation journey's status.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. The limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

page.description: Pagination returns the results in pages. Each page contains the number of results specified by the `limit` (default: 10).

items.description: A subscribers' journey through an automation flow.

id.description: The prefixed ID of the automation journey.

automation_id.description: The prefixed ID of the automation.

subscription_id.description: The prefixed ID of the subscription.

started_at.description: The time that the subscriber started their flow through the automation. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

completed_at.description: The time that the subscriber finished their flow through the automation. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

limit.description: The limit placed on the results. If no limit was specified in the request, this defaults to 10.

page.description: The page number the results are from. If no page was specified in the request, this defaults to page 1.

total_results.description: The total number of results from all pages.
